difficulty_reason: Pulls the finite flat presentation U -> X back to U' (affine by affine-over-well-nigh-affine), verifies the three cartesian diagrams (two by transitivity of fibre products, the stabilizer square by pulling back the inertia isomorphism), derives the invariant-ring identification M' = Spec of R'-invariants, and concludes M' -> M etale separated with the diagram cartesian.
